sub_limits_waiting_notes: Family floater policy. 3 plans (A/B/C). Includes maternity (24-month wait), infertility (24-month wait), domiciliary, doctor home visit, vaccinations. Reinstatement on RTA. Zonal copay structure. Optional CI, OPD, PED diabetes/HTN rider.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Plan A: 1% SI room/day or actual + 2% SI ICU/day or actual; Plans B/C: actuals
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Per insured person per day cap.

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Plan A: Up to Rs 1,00,000. Plans B/C: Up to Rs 2,00,000.

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Plan A: Rs 30K normal / Rs 50K caesarean. Plans B/C: actuals.
maternity_coverage.notes: 24-month waiting period. Includes Baby from Birth cover.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Baby from Birth covered under maternity

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Plan A: Rs 2,500 / Plan B: Rs 4,000 / Plan C: Rs 5,000 per insured per year

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Optional Cover (benefit-based lumpsum on CI diagnosis)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Reinstatement of Sum Insured due to Road Traffic Accident

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health Check Up every 2 years (Good Health Incentive)

room_rent_capping: Plan A: 1% SI/day per insured or actual; Plan B/C: actual
icu_capping: Plan A: 2% SI/day per insured or actual; Plan B/C: actual
copayment_trigger_notes: Zone-based copay: e.g. 22.5% if Zone IV premium but treated in Zone I; 10% if Zone IV premium but treated in Zone III. Zones: I=Mumbai/Gujarat; II=Delhi NCR/Chandigarh/Pune; III=Chennai/Hyd/Bangalore/Kolkata; IV=Rest. Plus optional 10%/20% copay for 12.5%/25% premium discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Plan A: 15% SI or Rs 60,000/eye (lower). Plan B/C: actuals.
disease_wise_sub_limits.hospital_cash: Plan A: Rs 500 / Plan B: Rs 1,000 / Plan C: Rs 2,000 per day max 5 days (after 3 days)
disease_wise_sub_limits.air_ambulance: Plan B/C: 5% of SI per year
disease_wise_sub_limits.anti_rabies_vaccination: Plan A: Rs 5,000 / Plan B/C: Rs 5,000
disease_wise_sub_limits.infertility: Plan A: Rs 50,000 / Plan B/C: Rs 1,00,000 per insured per year
disease_wise_sub_limits.vaccination_children: Plan A: Rs 1,000 / Plan B/C: actuals (male <=12yr, female <=14yr)
disease_wise_sub_limits.doctor_home_visit: Plan B: Rs 1,000 / Plan C: Rs 2,000 per day max 10 days (post-hosp nursing care)
disease_wise_sub_limits.pre_existing_diabetes_hypertension_optio: Year 1: 25% SI / Year 2: 50% SI / Year 3: 75% SI

notable_exclusions_summary: Family floater with maternity, infertility, domiciliary, doctor home visit, child vaccination. Optional CI, OPD, PED diabetes/HTN riders. Zonal copay based on premium zone vs treatment zone.
claim_process_summary: Cashless TPA at network/PPN; 1-hour pre-auth; 3-hour final bill TAT. Reimbursement within 15 days of discharge.
